before:
name: Contextual MTP receipts

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - research/mtp-context-depth-20260921/**
      - .github/workflows/mtp-context-receipts.yml
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: mtp-context-receipts-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  reproduce:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Archive-reader regressions
        run: |
          tools/unittest-floor.sh research/mtp-context-depth-20260921/publication 'test_*.py' 16

      - name: Reproduce both iterations and their expanded boundary reviews
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess
          import sys

          lane = Path("research/mtp-context-depth-20260921")
          tools = lane / "publication"
          for folder, program in [
              ("prior-receipts", "reproduce_development.py"),
              ("receipts", "reproduce.py"),
              ("latest-receipts", "reproduce_latest.py"),
          ]:
              receipts = lane / folder
              pin = (receipts / "manifest.sha256").read_text().split()[0]
              subprocess.run([
                  sys.executable, str(tools / program), "--receipts", str(receipts),
                  "--manifest-sha256", pin,
              ], check=True)
              subprocess.run([
                  sys.executable, str(tools / "verify_boundary.py"),
                  "--receipts", str(receipts),
                  "--review", str(receipts / "boundary-review.json"),
                  "--prefix", receipts.as_posix(), "--check",
              ], check=True)
          PY
